name: Ace Submarine
descriptionTemplate: Submarine units under command (excluding nuclear submarines) ignores enemy defense, and their attack range is increased by 1; after eliminating an enemy, there is a X% chance to attack again, and the chance can be increased by an additional 25% if a critical attack is dealt.

progression.renderedDesc: Submarine units under command (excluding nuclear submarines) ignores enemy defense, and their attack range is increased by 1; after eliminating an enemy, there is a 15% chance to attack again, and the chance can be increased by an additional 25% if a critical attack is dealt.
progression.renderedDescFr: Les sous-marins sous commandement (hors sous-marins nucléaires) ignorent la défense ennemie et leur portée d'attaque augmente de 1 ; après avoir éliminé un ennemi, 15% de chances d'attaquer à nouveau, chance augmentée de 25% supplémentaires en cas d'attaque critique.

longDesc: Compétence spécifique à un général. « As des sous-marins » monte jusqu'au niveau 5. Au niveau maximum (5), elle applique l'effet suivant : « Submarine unités sous votre commandement (excluding nuclear submarines) ignore ennemi défense, and their portée d'attaque is augmenté by 1; après avoir éliminé un ennemi, there is a 75% chance to attaque again, and the chance can be augmenté by an additional 25% if a attaques critiques is dealt. ». Signature de carte — impossible à remplacer, définit souvent l'identité tactique du général.
longDescEn: A general-specific skill. "Ace Submarine" scales up to level 5. At max level (5), the skill applies the following effect: "Submarine units under command (excluding nuclear submarines) ignores enemy defense, and their attack range is increased by 1; after eliminating an enemy, there is a 75% chance to attack again, and the chance can be increased by an additional 25% if a critical attack is dealt.". A card signature — cannot be swapped; it often defines the general's tactical identity.
longDescDe: Eine generalspezifische Fähigkeit. „Ace Submarine“ skaliert bis Stufe 5. Auf Maximalstufe (5) wirkt folgender Effekt: „Submarine units under command (excluding nuclear submarines) ignores enemy defense, and their attack range is increased by 1; after eliminating an enemy, there is a 75% chance to attack again, and the chance can be increased by an additional 25% if a critical attack is dealt.“. Eine Karten-Signatur — nicht austauschbar, prägt oft die taktische Identität des Generals.
